speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Safety is also a key part of the vocational licence curriculum for bus drivers.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Transport)
text: Bus operators, such as SBST, are trialling new technologies to help monitor and improve driving behaviours.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: I am concerned about the mental well-being of our drivers of heavy vehicles and buses.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: I am wondering whether there are processes and checks in place to ensure that these drivers are provided with counselling support if they require it, because this affects their ability to drive well and safe.
